  "hypothesis_updates": "H1 — Supported with refinement, based on observed measurements. The corresponding V2 increase grows from about 0.13 ml at 2/1 to 2.39 ml at 50/1. This supports a local ratio/loading interaction; it does not establish complete separability or universal loading behavior.

H2 — Partially supported locally. Matched measured contrasts now show loading sensitivity, but endpoint directions differ. H3 — Supported as local error structure. m160 has small V2 premeasurement errors at 2/1 despite the earlier 52.81 ml underprediction at 5/1. m216 was overpredicted by 11.63/10.36 ml at 5/1 (33ffc69a253a89f15995), whereas its earlier 10/1 prediction missed by -27.69/-41.93 ml (e47aebe2660b9e1528de). New large underpredictions for m212 and m146 coexist with overprediction for m211. These residuals come from successive model versions, so they cannot be treated as one current residual surface. Broad polar-group or basic-nitrogen offsets remain inappropriate.

H4 — The historical premise remains rejected. Both measured m13/m80 endpoints and their recorded premeasurement predictions are ordered. Separately, genuine endpoint crossings occur in current candidate predictions, including 02ddeed8a16d3adf3e28, which predicts V1/V2 of 6.198/5.086 ml. That current diagnostic does not validate the old rationale or establish a measured ordering defect.

H5 — Supported, but the pervasive loading explanation is weakened. At m125 5/1 with 300 µl loading-solvent volume, 100 and 150 µl loads give similar endpoints: 42.958/73.100 (74cf50c6ec476a394b01) and 42.267/74.042 (549daca56bed1c9d2bcc). Current prediction diagnostic: loading responses are frequently almost flat. The two missing m125 2/1 factorial corners predict approximately 23.1/47.5 ml despite different amount/solvent-volume combinations. Their near equality matters because the measured diagonal corners differ substantially. Similar flat loading predictions recur across familiar and novel molecular grids. Low nominal uncertainty can therefore accompany a useful test of systematic explanations.

Quantile diagnostic: V1 q10 repeatedly equals zero, making its nominal width largely track endpoint scale. Quantiles also cross: candidate 9c06d41471b0bc70e4c7 has V2 q10 10.223 above q90 10.102 and a negative nominal width. Other medians exceed q90. Intermediate ratios around m125, m146, m212, m31 and m92 can test slope transfer or a localized transition. Another nearly identical tail row may mainly reproduce an existing correction.

ML hypothesis: weak use of loading features is plausible, especially for V1. Matched measurements can expose this even when predictions barely change. The supplied evidence does not identify whether the cause is representation, regularization, sparse contrasts or unrecorded experimental factors.

Observed evidence: identical recorded inputs sometimes have materially different labels. The m174 records at 30/1, 50 µl and 200 µl PE loading solvent, 704ba630f25fe7f20166 and 92bac523bed1042d6a75, differ by about 4.68 ml on V1 and 5.93 ml on V2. The two m105 10/1, 150 µl records differ by about 2.08 ml on V2. Repetition is useful when it estimates such variability or tests a model ambiguity.

  "coverage_or_redundancy_concerns": "The supplied pool contains many exact condition duplicates under different IDs. Assess marginal information using molecule identity and all five condition fields; retain duplicate multiplicity when assessing the Row distribution.

Some legal candidates duplicate already measured inputs. Their labels primarily address reproducibility, hidden variation or a loading-insensitive prediction. A new ID alone does not establish new coverage.

The pool spans familiar low-volume halogenated/nonpolar compounds and ester/carbonyl families, alongside unmeasured molecules such as m107, m37, m47, m117, m116, m129, m191, m205 and m206. Novelty is more useful when attached to an interpretable family or condition comparison than as an isolated maximum-distance point.

Similarity-to-pending adds no diversity information because pending is empty. Similarity-to-observed is molecular: a value of 1 does not establish condition coverage, and a close analogue need not share a response curve.

The previous emphasis on m167 and m105 has resolved several questions. Broader molecular coverage and unresolved local contrasts now offer plausible higher marginal value, without implying a fixed exploration allocation.",
